study.question: Does the sign of the occupied-row centered auxiliary product-context cotangent explain the retained click-AUC benefit, and does retaining the batch-mean component modify that sign effect?
study.hypothesis: Observed trajectories motivate a direction control, not another forward architecture. The imported joint model reaches click AUC0.668457307891 versus DIN0.655544082420. g3-r0030-joint_replay exactly reproduces that value; click-only is0.667854872059 and auxiliary label rolling is0.667463946581. Product-only full transfer reaches0.668415615994, native centered transfer0.668362209030, and blocking product transfer0.667854872059. The mean-only branch is worse at0.667705226462; restoring centered norm to full norm also loses AUC at0.668256200549. The latest centered half-swap lowers AUC to0.668120227587 but remains0.000265355528 above the blocked reference; full half-swap reaches0.667910868783. These null/negative and positive paths do not identify whether useful centered direction or a generic zero-mean optimization perturbation accounts for the remaining benefit. Provisional mechanism: the native sign of centered auxiliary information contributes useful shared context updates. Reversing that sign at identical edge norm should reduce click AUC. A mean-presence factorial tests whether this effect depends on the occupied-row mean. All evidence is one frozen seed, and diagnostics were not requested in the latest receipts; no gradient-conflict measurement or independent repetition is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: For each auxiliary product-context input edge during training, let H be nonempty-history rows, A_i=G_i on H and0 elsewhere, M_i=mean_H(A) on H and0 elsewhere, and C=A-M. Cross mean absence/presence with centered orientation: centered_aligned returns C; centered_reversed returns -C; full_aligned returns the unchanged incoming G (equal to A after the existing has_history gate); full_reflected returns M-C=2M-A. Identity forward is unchanged; the VJP is an explicit first-order surrogate, not a scalar-objective derivative. All cells use aligned example assignment and native magnitude. Centered negation occurs after output casting for exact representable negation. Full reflection reduces/reconstructs in FP32 then casts. In exact arithmetic M is orthogonal to C, so reflection preserves the full edge Frobenius norm; centered reversal also preserves each row norm. All-empty and one-occupied cases are defined without division by zero. No equal-optimizer-step or equal-measured-cost claim follows from these edge identities.
predictions: At identical initialized or diagnostic nonzero-adapter state, every cell has identical train/eval probabilities, true-label loss values, parameters, buffers, RNG evolution and private task/click derivatives. Only the declared auxiliary context input VJP differs. Aligned controls match the corresponding ancestors.

If the sign carries useful local information, AUC(centered_aligned)-AUC(centered_reversed)>0 and AUC(full_aligned)-AUC(full_reflected)>0. A prespecified absolute AUC difference of0.0001 is the practical follow-up threshold, not a significance threshold.

The interaction I=[AUC(full_aligned)-AUC(full_reflected)]-[AUC(centered_aligned)-AUC(centered_reversed)] distinguishes mean-dependent direction effects. Treat |I|<0.0001 as a small interaction at this seed. A larger interaction requires confirmation rather than additive component attribution.

Capacity and inference graph are unchanged: expected32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense parameters. Host must remeasure cost, memory, latency and throughput; reversal/reflection adds small backward work and may change the whole training trajectory.
falsifiers: If reversing C retains comparable or better click AUC in both mean settings, the proposed beneficial native-sign explanation is unsupported at this seed; retain the measured auxiliary-supervision benefit separately and investigate generic optimization or shared-ID structure. Do not interpret equality as equivalence without uncertainty.
If the sign effect exists only in one mean setting or changes sign, a mean-independent centered-direction explanation fails; report interaction and pursue a matched follow-up only if consequential.

Nonidentical common-state predictions/private gradients/buffers, nonzero blocked-edge gradients, wrong masking, invalid norms/empty-row behavior, or failure of an aligned replay invalidates mechanism interpretation. Stop the affected host run, retain its costs and resolve implementation/protocol provenance before comparison.

Single-seed directional differences that do not recur under later host-authorized paired repetitions falsify a reproducible mechanism claim; validation-only improvements do not establish held-out benefit.
alternative_explanations: Adagrad/AdamW trajectory changes or effective auxiliary gradient scale after embedding-ID collisions rather than semantic auxiliary information.
Native centered transfer supplies generic zero-mean perturbations; half-swap partially preserves useful structure because examples share field IDs or batch population properties.
Mean and centered components interact through private auxiliary learning, shared representations or optimizers. Mean-only underperformance does not imply the mean is always harmful.
Dense clipping, sparse coalescing, BF16 rounding, constant/nearconstant gradients and zero-initialized adapter output layers may conceal or distort edge effects.

Adaptive validation search, one seed, auxiliary label semantics and inherited whole-window vocabularies/offline feedback visibility limit generalization. No timestamps/IDs beyond the authorized tensors are inferred.
